title: Bingus SMP Content
description: Extra content made for the Bingus SMP.
body:
This mod features various new blocks, items, and features made for the Bingus SMP, a publicly available SMP. These include, but are not limited to:
- Prismarine Ore: Gives Prismarine Shards and Crystals upon mining, which is boosted by Fortune. Includes a Deepslate variant and naturally spawns underground beneath oceans.
- End Respawn Anchor: Allows players to set their respawn point in the End. Takes Ender Pearls as charge. (Can be disabled in the config)
- New decorative blocks, such as a scarecrow block, new mob heads, and colored paint blocks.
- Paint Bombs: TNT-like blocks that spread their respective paint upon exploding.
- Ebony Wood: A new wood type. Includes trees that naturally spawn in Sparse Jungles.
- Redstone Shrieker: Releases the Warden's shriek attack when recieving a Redstone signal. Has low damage and very high knockback.
- Genetic Compass: A compass-like item that tracks the nearest player within 64 blocks. (Range can be defined in the config)
- Cleavers: A new tiered weapon that has a 30% chance to drop mob heads on kill. Also works with Player heads and the new mob heads.
- Can now load Echo Shards into Crossbows. Shoots Echo Shard projectiles that inflict entities with Darkness and convert blocks to Sculk. (Can be disabled in the config)
- Trial vaults are now infinitely reusable for players. (Can be disabled in the config)
- Backported the Lava Chicken music disc from 1.21.7.

Just Enough Items is recommended for the best experience.
You are allowed to use this mod in your own modpacks and release them to the public. However, you cannot redistribute this mod to other sites. CurseForge and Modrinth are the only official release sites for this mod.
